newsitem.title: GERMANY: Koebnick-no early change in Buba interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Koebnick-no early change in Buba interest rates.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Hans-Juergen Koebnick said on Wednesday that he saw no need for a change in interest rates any time soon, adding that it was also unclear which direction the next move would take.
"From today's point of view I see no reason that would suggest a change of the current policy in the near future," Koebnick told a news conference.

"The monetary environment at the moment signals no need for action either upward or downwards. When, and in what direction, the next German interest rate change will be made is therefore a completely open question at the moment," he added.
